neighbours.label: negation of an expected response inside a conditional (if you have not heard back, if you don't receive)
fire: Contact the support team if you haven't received your refund within ten days.
If your package has not arrived by Monday, reply to this email with the order number.
If they don't answer the phone, leave a message with your name and number.
Should you not hear from the committee by June, assume the grant was declined.
If the password reset link does not show up, check that the address is correct.
Let me know if you didn't get the invitation and I'll send it again.
If you still haven't gotten a reply by Friday, call the clinic directly.
If the doctor does not call you back within two days, phone the front desk.
quiet: Contact the support team when you have received your refund to confirm it.
Your package has not been opened, so you can still return it for free.
If they answer the phone, ask them about the opening hours.
We have not heard such good music in years, said the critic.
If the password reset link shows up, click it within an hour.
I didn't get much sleep because the neighbors were loud.
If you get a reply by Friday, forward it to me right away.
The doctor does not work on Sundays, so the clinic is closed.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.8 on negated expectation in an if-clause; plain negations and un-negated conditionals below 0.17
notes: Card: peaks on ''t', ' not', ' unable' in 'if you don't see', 'if you have not heard', 'If you do not hear back'; - side output favours ' after', ' shortly'. Probe: 'if you have not heard' 0.824, 'do not hear back' 0.738, 'If you don't receive' 0.576, 'doesn't help' 0.286, 'is unable to reach' 0.152; un-negated 'If you receive' 0.164, 'If the medicine helps' 0.053, plain 'has not visited' 0.048, 'I don't like coffee' 0.030. Near misses split the two parts: negation outside a conditional, or a conditional without negation.
